title: Partially Observed McKean--Vlasov Control with Vanishing Observation Intensities
summary: We study partially observed McKean--Vlasov jump-diffusions with controlled counting intensities that may vanish and depend on the unconditional physical state distribution. A deterministic upper bound on the likelihood supports one-sided state--likelihood variations, a smooth-test-function expansion of the physical state marginal, and a necessary maximum principle without inverse intensity or likelihood terms.
